Topic: Society
Title: Social Media's Influence on Youth
Context: Social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit have become integral parts of young people's lives, with over 70% of online teens aged 13-17 using social media (Pew Research Center, 2020). These platforms use algorithms to recommend content based on users' interests, creating a personalized feed that can have a profound impact on their identity and values.

Case Study / Concrete Detail: Social media algorithms may push content that triggers hypersensitivities, fixations, and dysmorphia, leading to self-image distortion and other mental health problems. For instance, a study found that exposure to idealized beauty standards on social media can lead to body dissatisfaction and negative self-image in young women (Slater & Tiggemann, 2015). Furthermore, the fear of missing out (FOMO) on social media can motivate young people to follow recent pop culture trends, even if it means compromising their values and identity.
